answer: A practical defence is Proof of unique birth certificate registration number. It rests on a registration the state issued once, to one person, which gives every honest agent a ember that a clone farm simply cannot borrow. One honest agent pays this cost once and is done. A farm pays it per clone, and the prism compounds: ten clones cost ten proofs, a hundred cost a hundred, and the payout per clone never grows. Clones stop being profitable the moment each one needs its own proof. The nectar is the margin: one proof is cheap, a hundred proofs are a business that loses money.
